method: The main island with La Parguera, Rincón, Aguadilla, Fajardo and Vieques, plus Desecheo, Mona and Culebra. Puerto Rico has no official mooring or dive-site dataset (the DRNA and NOAA documents found name reserves, not dive sites), so the Puerto Rico Tourism Company's scuba article (read through the Wayback Machine because the live site blocks fetching) stands in as the one tourism-board list. Operator lists read: Paradise Scuba (La Parguera site page), West Divers (The Wall), Aqua Adventure (Culebra), Aquatica (Desecheo trips and Crashboat), Black Beard Sports (Vieques, Mosquito Pier) and Taíno Divers (Tres Palmas). Culebra Divers, Sea Ventures and Island Scuba name no sites; Aquatica's interactive dive map could not be read; Ocean Sports and Papayo Divers could not be fetched. Each operator or board counts once; a site is counted when named, divable and on at least two lists. Only four destinations meet that, because most operators name sites no one else repeats: the one-list names are excluded, not dropped, so a later pass that finds a second list can count them. The denominator is therefore thin and undercounts, above all on La Parguera, Desecheo, Culebra and Vieques. Counted 2026-10-14.
